Add two optional selections to the `"cc-and-walk"` track building in `GNNTrackFinder`, following acorn's `bestpred_walk` and `min_track_score`:

data.title: [pre-edm4hep1] Vertexing: fix out-of-bounds reads, uninitialised fields, the SV pointing angle and fits with a dropped track
data.author: defranchis
data.body:
## Summary

Five independent fixes:

1. `get_pointingangle_SV` (both overloads): the x component of the flight vector was always 0 (`r_vtx[0] - r_vtx[0]`). The getter now agrees with `get_PV2V0angle`, which the V0 finder uses. Before, the median difference in cos was 0.12, and only about 4 % of the V0s accepted by the finder at cos > 0.999 passed 0.999 with the getter.
2. data.title: PythiaInterface: print statistics once at finalize, not per event
data.author: kjvbrt
data.body:
Hi,

BEGINRELEASENOTES
 - `PythiaInterface`: print the Pythia statistics once in `finalize()` instead of after every event.
 - `PythiaInterface`: deprecate the `printPythiaStatistics` property; it has no effect and only prints a warning when set.
 - `PythiaInterface`: add `printPythiaStatisticsEveryNEvents` (default 0 = disabled) to also print the statistics every N events.

ENDRELEASENOTES

`printPythiaStatistics` called `Pythia::stat()` from `getNextEvent()`, so it printed the full statistics block after every generated event. At scale (e.g. 100k events/job) this floods stdout and can overrun a job's captured-output buffer, killing the job partway through.

data.title: fix(env): set LD_LIBRARY_PATH also on macOS
data.author: wdconinc
data.body:
Although macOS doesn't use `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`, ROOT still uses it, and with precedence over `DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH` (https://github.com/root-project/root/blob/v6-40-02/interpreter/cling/lib/Interpreter/DynamicLibraryManager.cpp#L30-L56). That means that a compilation in an environment with an existing DD4hep (such as LCG in CI), the existing DD4hep will be picked up by cling before the version loaded by `thisdd4hep.sh`. That's a consequence of LCG's views where the `setup.sh` adds the view/lib to `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`.

This PR just makes sure that we then also add (prepend) this DD4hep before the one in the `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` already.

Maybe the real issue here is that ROOT shouldn't look in `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` at all on macOS but we can't change that.
